wolfram.note: NestList(Function(Symbol("x")), {a}, 5): compute-engine broadcasts an anonymous Function call over a List argument (threads over its elements) even when the function's body never references its argument and the list is meant to be one opaque accumulator value, not a collection to map over -- confirmed with both a direct Apply(fn, {a}) and a bare [["Function",...], {a}] call, both of which return [x] instead of x. This is CE's own function-application/broadcasting machinery treating any List-valued call argument as Listable-threadable, independent of the lazy-collection-materialization issue fixed elsewhere in this lane (Most/Rest/FoldList). A real but deep architectural issue -- touches how anonymous Function values get invoked generally, well beyond this lane's budget to patch safely.
